item.title: 企业正为简单AI查询多付费——Snowflake网关现可自动路由降本达3倍
item.summary: Enterprise teams running AI agents at scale are finding that a single model handles every task poorly — either the model is too expensive for simple questions or not capable enough for hard ones.
